variants.headline: Home world punishes the colony
variants.body: The home world has punished the colony. We hold {target} responsible for inadequate political judgment and insist upon a more demanding public standard.

variants.headline: A sanction enters the colonial relationship
variants.body: A punishment has been imposed on {colony} by the home world. We hold {target} responsible for inadequate political judgment and insist upon a more demanding public standard.

variants.headline: Authority takes a punitive turn
variants.body: The colony is the subject of punitive action by the home world. We hold {target} responsible for inadequate political judgment and insist upon a more demanding public standard.
